  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-008 is a clear, specific, and verifiable software requirement specifying that the SFMC must display a low-fuel warning when fuel is below 15% of usable capacity. It is consistent with the propulsion system interface described in the SRS (Section 2.3) where fuel level is reported to the SFMC. The requirement is well-written, unambiguous, and testable. No undefined terms or vague criteria are present. No software allocation issues are identified as the SFMC software is responsible for displaying warnings per the SRS scope. No applicable SWE linkage is justified based on the supplied NPR passages. The requirement aligns with NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 guidance on clear and complete software requirements."
